$comment: Presentation and sign-in metadata for loop's model providers. Which providers EXIST and whether they are connected comes from loop at runtime (auth.providers); this file only says how each one looks and what its login asks for. A provider missing from here still renders — as a lettermark with a generic API-key form — so loop can add one without this file blocking it.

providers.label: Anthropic
providers.tagline: Claude models, direct from Anthropic.

login.label: API key
login.hint: Create a key in the Anthropic Console.

providers.label: OpenAI
providers.tagline: GPT models — pay-as-you-go, or your ChatGPT plan.

login.label: Sign in with ChatGPT
login.hint: Opens a browser. Turns are billed to your ChatGPT subscription through the Codex backend — personal use only.

login.label: API key
login.hint: Pay-as-you-go, billed to your OpenAI platform account.

providers.label: ChatGPT
providers.tagline: GPT models on your ChatGPT plan, through the Codex backend.

login.label: Sign in with ChatGPT
login.hint: Opens a browser. Turns are billed to your ChatGPT subscription through the Codex backend — personal use only.

providers.label: xAI
providers.tagline: Grok models — SuperGrok subscription or a platform key.

login.label: Sign in with xAI
login.hint: Opens a browser. Uses your SuperGrok subscription.

login.label: API key
login.hint: Pay-as-you-go, billed to your xAI console account.

providers.label: Google
providers.tagline: Gemini models via the Google AI API.

login.label: API key
login.hint: Create a key in Google AI Studio.

providers.label: OpenRouter
providers.tagline: One key, hundreds of models across vendors.

login.label: API key
login.hint: Real per-request cost is reported back by OpenRouter.

providers.label: GitHub Copilot
providers.tagline: Models included with your Copilot seat.

login.label: Sign in with GitHub
login.hint: Device flow: loop shows a code, you enter it on github.com. Asks for a GitHub Enterprise domain first — leave it blank for github.com.

providers.label: DeepSeek
providers.tagline: DeepSeek chat and reasoning models.

providers.label: Mistral
providers.tagline: Mistral's hosted models.

providers.label: Zhipu GLM
providers.tagline: GLM models on open.bigmodel.cn (China endpoint).

login.label: API key
login.hint: For the international endpoint, connect z.ai instead.

providers.label: z.ai
providers.tagline: The same GLM models on the international endpoint.

providers.label: Kimi
providers.tagline: Moonshot AI — K2 and K3, with reasoning.

login.label: API key
login.hint: A Kimi Code subscription key (sk-kimi-…) routes to the coding endpoint; a plain platform key (sk-…) routes to pay-per-token.

providers.label: Groq
providers.tagline: Open models served fast on Groq's LPUs.

providers.label: Cerebras
providers.tagline: Open models on Cerebras inference.

providers.label: ZenMux
providers.tagline: Gateway — 200+ models behind one key.

providers.label: Vercel AI Gateway
providers.tagline: Gateway — 200+ models, native AI SDK wire protocol.

login.label: API key
login.hint: An AI Gateway key — not a Vercel platform/deploy token.

providers.label: Amazon Bedrock
providers.tagline: Models in your AWS account — no key stored by loop.

login.label: Detect AWS credentials
login.hint: Uses the standard AWS chain — env vars, shared config, SSO, IMDS — the same sources the aws CLI reads. Set AWS_REGION or LOOP_BEDROCK_REGION to change region.

providers.label: Ollama
providers.tagline: Models running locally — no key, no network.

login.label: Check local daemon
login.hint: Needs `ollama serve` running with at least one model pulled. Set LOOP_OLLAMA_BASE_URL to point elsewhere.

providers.label: Claude Code
providers.tagline: Your installed Claude Code, on its own sign-in — loop stores nothing.

login.label: Detect Claude Code
login.hint: Needs the `claude` CLI on this machine, signed in (`claude auth login`). Set LOOP_CLAUDE_CODE_BIN to use a specific binary.

providers.label: Cursor
providers.tagline: Your installed Cursor agent CLI, on its own sign-in — loop stores nothing.

login.label: Detect Cursor CLI
login.hint: Needs `cursor-agent` on this machine, signed in (`cursor-agent login`) or with CURSOR_API_KEY set. Set LOOP_CURSOR_AGENT_BIN to use a specific binary.
